summary: Conditional destructor that tears down the object's sub-resources via DestructorWithFree(this), then, only when the thiscall flag byte a2 has bit 0 set, releases the object memory itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf(this). Returns the this pointer.

local_names.a2: destructor flag byte; bit 0 selects heap deallocation

operations.description: Run the base cleanup path: DestructorWithFree(this).
If the low bit of a2 is set (a2 & 1 != 0), proceed to deallocate the object.
